title: The packet receipt types gain optional authored-generation sections, and the packet line helpers are shared
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports from the package root the HostHookDeclaration, PacketDefinition, OperationDefinition, HarnessDefinition and RegistrationRow types. PacketReceipt gains five optional sections: generated (GeneratedRow: record identity, word agent-profile or playbook, path and SHA-256 of each generated file), definitions (PacketDefinition rows, a union of {word: 'operation', definition: OperationDefinition} and {word: 'harness', definition: HarnessDefinition}), hooks (HookGroupRow: each registered group's `@hook` identity, the tools that hook declares and the SHA-256 of the group as written), removedHooks (RemovedHookRow: each group an apply removed, by `@hook` identity and the SHA-256 of the group as last registered) and unsupported (UnsupportedRow: identity, word agent-profile, playbook or hook, and reason); HostOutput gains an optional hooks (HostHookDeclaration: identity, event PreToolUse, the edit tools, the path selections and the message). The package root also exports GeneratedRow, HookGroupRow, RemovedHookRow, UnsupportedRow and the word unions GeneratedFileWord, GeneratedRecordWord, DefinitionWord and HookToolName, each stated once. The ./internal/packet-host subpath also exports inline, code and prose, the line folding, code span and IA-word code span helpers the entry file is written with. Limits: renderHost fills none of the new sections and its output, the packet and its digest are unchanged; the CLI's projection writer fills them, and a receipt without them still reads; ownership stays the projection state, not the receipt.
